title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-04 (PIN S1/D7/R2, model-switch slot + projection + merged CMO) — in-session /model switch sol -> qwen3.8-27b on the ACP driver (frozen lane L-01 for the parent; the qwen arm rides lane L-04). Scenario per 06: the v2 gate slot moves to the new model, the switch projection is applied, the merged CMO carries BOTH reasoning_summary (theirs) and cache_ttl (ours), and no foreign reasoning replays on the new wire (R8 suppression intact). Wire faces (the slot/CMO are struct-level; their observable wire surfaces are pinned here, the struct-level round-trip is the M15 crate test in the full gate): (1) SLOT MOVE: post-switch turns hit body.model=qwen3.8-27b on /v1/responses (the spec slot write is the only way the switch turns reach qwen); (2) PROJECTION: cursor pinned to ultra (config_patch models/default_reasoning_effort=ultra) — ultra is NOT in the qwen menu {xhigh, medium, low} (live config, re-verified 2026-09-18) so the switch must project to the TARGET DEFAULT xhigh on the qwen wire (the at-effort-2hop remap chain; the D7 A1-rewritten SessionModelSwitch carries the projection); a raw max/ultra on a qwen request = the R5 leak class = defect; (3) CMO-REASONING-SUMMARY (theirs-side field survived the merge): the qwen request carries the 'summary' CMO field on the wire (responses reasoning block); (4) CMO-CACHE-TTL (ours-side field): pinned wire-side on the messages lane by MXAI-C03 head_ttl_1h (cross-reference — the same CMO field); this cell records its presence on the responses surface via recon; (5) R8 SUPPRESSION: no sol-era encrypted_content may ride into ANY post-switch qwen request (the foreign-reasoning strip at the model boundary). PREMISE (anti-vacuous): a pre-switch sol request must carry real foreign reasoning items ('"type": "reasoning"' input) — 0-hit = the model produced no reasoning to suppress = VACUOUS. VERDICT: PASS = slot moved, projection = xhigh (no max/ultra leak), summary field present, R8 clean, final qwen turn 200 + exact terminal text. STOP-AND-REPORT: a 400/503 on the qwen boundary, a raw max/ultra wire effort on qwen, any encrypted_content on a qwen request, or an acp_error.

steps.prompt: Compute 7^8432 mod 5557 using modular exponentiation. Show each squaring step briefly, then state the final remainder on its own line. Do not use any tools.

steps.note: WIRE READ (recon_note, non-scoring): the qwen requests (body.model=qwen3.8-27b on /v1/responses) are the post-switch evidence — slot write (model), projection (effort xhigh), CMO reasoning_summary (summary field), R8 (encrypted_content absence). The sol requests carry the pre-switch foreign reasoning (the premise). The merged CMO's cache_ttl half is pinned wire-side on the messages lane by MXAI-C03 head_ttl_1h (same CMO field, different wire face); the struct-level CMO round-trip (M15 drift guard) is a crate test in the wave-3 full gate (06 C-06).

ndjson.label: SESSION SURVIVES THE SWITCH: the post-switch qwen turns did not die (200 directly, or a 400 recovered by the reactive strip) — a 400/503 on the qwen boundary surfacing here = the switch path regressed (S1/R2) -> STOP.
POST-SWITCH TURN COMPLETES: the final qwen turn delivered the exact terminal text — both switch and post-switch turns closed.

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): a pre-switch sol request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real foreign reasoning exists to cross the model boundary. Without this, the R8 suppression pin is vacuous (the model produced no reasoning to suppress).

SLOT MOVE PIN (the v2 gate spec-slot write, 06 C-04): post-switch turns hit qwen3.8-27b on /v1/responses — 2 = the clean shape (Q1 + Q2); 1 = one switch turn landed (adjudicate); >4 = storm around the switch -> STOP. 0 = the slot did not move (the switch wrote nothing) = defect.

SWITCH PROJECTION PIN (D7/R2): the newest qwen request carries wire effort xhigh — the carried ultra is NOT in the qwen menu {xhigh, medium, low}, so the switch projection must land on the TARGET DEFAULT xhigh. Absent = the projection did not apply (the raw cursor rode the boundary) = defect.

LEAK GUARD (R5 class): no raw 'max' effort (the sol ultra remap) may leak onto ANY qwen request — the carried value must project to the target default, never ride its raw/remapped value. Present = the projection gate regressed -> STOP.
LEAK GUARD: no raw 'ultra' local tier may reach the wire on a qwen request (ultra is a local menu tier, never a wire value).

MERGED CMO — reasoning_summary (THEIRS-side field, 06 C-04): the post-switch qwen request carries the 'summary' CMO field on the responses reasoning block — the theirs-side CMO member survived the merge onto the wire. The struct-level round-trip (both fields, M15 drift guard) is the crate test in the full gate; the ours-side cache_ttl wire face is MXAI-C03 head_ttl_1h.

R8 SUPPRESSION PIN (intact through the merge): NO sol-era encrypted_content item may survive into ANY post-switch qwen request — the foreign-reasoning strip at the model boundary must catch every boundary-marker item (0 tolerance). Present = foreign reasoning replayed on the new wire = defect -> STOP.
POST-SWITCH ACCEPTED: the final qwen request reached 200 (the switch boundary did not 400/503 — a rejection here = new phrasing -> STOP, house rule).

CMO-WIRE RECORD (recon, all qwen requests): the reasoning block shape on the post-switch wire (effort + summary values) — the coordinator's cross-reference for the merged CMO (both fields) alongside the M15 crate-test result from the full gate.
